name: io.github.MyMolt/sigil-mcp-server
description: MCP security middleware: secret scanning, policy enforcement, Ed25519-signed audit. Rust, EUPL-1.2.

environmentVariables.name: SIGIL_MIN_SEVERITY
environmentVariables.description: Minimum severity to block (Low/Medium/High/Critical). Default: High.

environmentVariables.name: SIGIL_OFFLINE
environmentVariables.description: Run fully offline, no network calls (true/false). Default: true.

environmentVariables.name: SIGIL_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Path to tamper-evident audit log file.

environmentVariables.name: SIGIL_PRIVKEY
environmentVariables.description: Ed25519 private key seed (hex) for signing. Auto-generated if unset.
